# Arrivals, onion type and price swings: auto-generated findings

**Verify each number against the CSVs before publishing. Data window: Jan 2020 to Jul 2022.**

- Within the same market, a 10% higher average daily arrival goes with about **-0.3%** change in price (95% interval -0.6% to 0.0%; 29 markets, 2,570 market-weeks, p=0.059). Association, not proof of cause.
- Summer (Unhali) vs red (Lal) onion at the same market and week: median premium 3% over 101 market-weeks; premium ranges from -11% (month 1) to 40% (month 10).
- Largest 4-week price rise (state median): **31 Aug 2020**, +162% to Rs 1,700/quintal.
- Largest 4-week price fall: **15 Mar 2021**, -69% to Rs 1,042/quintal.
